nom: ILIA Bright Start Retinol Alternative Brightening Eye Cream

avis.texte: This product is luxurious going on! It feels so cool and moisturizing on the under eyes! Makes makeup application so much nicer! Big fan!

avis.titre: Keep going back again and again...even with the price tag
avis.texte: I've used this product off and on for about a year or so. It's not a miracle cure but when I've switched to other brands I always miss Ilia. It's a great moisturizer that's light enough to use on the lids but provides noticeable smoothness. For me, it brightens better and more naturally than any undereye makeup/concealer I've used. This is perfect on its own for me. The price is what keeps me trying other things! Every time I go to replenish it's such a painful purchase but, for me, it's worth it.

I usually LOVE ilia products, but this was a huge bummer. This is essentially the ilia moisturizer in a little package. I didnt notice any sort of dark circle coverage or brightening really past it just being a simple moisturizer but for that price? Absolutely not.
While this product does brighten somewhat, I find that it doesn't absorb as well as other eye creams. I find Origin's Ginzing Refreshing Eye Cream to be superior all around.
Love this eye cream for instantly brightening my under eye area as well as hydrating and eliminating my fine lines. My skin feels soft and hydrated all day!
It's my second time buying this eye cream. I love it! It goes on smooth and has an added glow that actually helps brighten the under eye area, which is exactly what I was looking for.
A great way to refresh your under eyes. Goes on smoothly and doesn't peel or slide during the day. This little gem blends evenly under or over my makeup.
Love how this eye cream instantly perks up my eyes. Amazing moisture that lasts and I looove the slight shimmer and warm tone
I tried this as a sample and HAD to order because it works! Brightens without shimmer and the applicator is amazing. I will be a repeat customer on this one!
Love the applicator and cool feeling. Tint was a great match too.

i use this everyday under my makeup and i can definitely say this really works !! You notice the difference right away and the cooling effect feels amazing !! Thank you for a great product !! Will definitely purchase again !!

I like this. I like the idea of putting it on and using the other side to smooth it in. Seems to be working and I've only been using it a couple weeks. At 62, I already see a difference. Definitely putting it on reorder.
This is one of the best eye cream I've tried. Have tried others but this one I like the most.
This product leaves the skin around my eyes refreshed after my long shifts at home. Its very gently and does not have a strong scent to irritate my eyes.
Lightweight and love the cooling applicator, my eyes look great
Just what I was hoping for … at my age I am concerned with the lines and crow feet — ugh! This product does help, and I do notice a difference (especially when I skip a few days).
This product works well. It is an eye brightener. I just have to remember to use it!
I've only been using it for a few days but it feels good on my very sensitive skin!!
Perfect eye cream for everyday. Goes on smoothly and helps my eyes wake up on those tough days.
It totally helped reduce the appearance of the bags under my eyes
It gives an instant glow when applying. I haven't been using long enough to see long term effects
I've been using this eye cream for an over a year and really like it. It goes on smoothly and does brighten the eye area. It can be used with or without fouundation. It's part of my AM routine!!

I've only been using this a very short while, so I can't say whether it will improve my eye area. I keep mine in the refrigerator, and I love the way it feels to apply the cold product. It does leave a nice brightened appearance. My only complaint so far is that it looks very shiny under fluorescent lights; it gives me a raccoonish look in that lighting and enhances to look of bagginess. In sunlight or other forms of lighting I don't notice this.
I have very dark circles genetically & a toddler who doesn't sleep well so this is a must!
I love this eye cream! It's bright, lightweight and cooling on the eyes. Gives my eyes hydration with a nice glow!
Ordered this a multiple times- I am obsessed,best under eye cream. I apply it in the mornings, prior to make up application and even in the evenings for the hydration.💜

I love Ilia as a brand. I love their ingredients, I love the fact that they feature senior models in their ads, I love their ingredients, and in general, I've never had an issue with their products. So, when I went on the hunt for a good daytime eye cream, I was excited to see that their eye treatment got reviews and seemed to have plenty of skin-friendly ingredients. I will admit that I was initially concerned about the presence of retinol and including it in a product that I would use daily (I typically use retinol only 1 to 2x per week); but I figured if Ilia created something meant to be used daily, that retinol would be formulated to be safe for daily use. HOWEVER, all that being said… About a week after I began using this eye cream, I noticed that my eyeshadow primers that I was using were BURNING when I applied them. No other product was causing this reaction. Just my primer. At first I blamed the primer and got rid of it; and tried a different one, one that I have never had any issues with in the past. Same problem: I experienced a SEARING HOT BURNING sensation the moment I applied this product. It just then occurred to me that is very likely due to this Ilia eye cream, and it's retinol content. I am so disappointed. I love Ilia, but some of us are just too sensitive for daily applications of retinol; and I hope come out with a new product without it.
It helps with brightening under eye area. I tried the tester before and wanted to buy the full size. I will test it more for long term to see additional benefits.

This feels great in the morning as part of your routine. I feel like it reduces puffiness and at the same time soothes dehydrated skin both under the eye and and on the brow line/upper lid. I've purchased again.
It definitely moisturizes my eyes but it doesn't help with any dark circles or wrinkles or brightening or puffiness.
Haven't uses long enough.. Very nice feeling, hope it will help…
I can't say enough on how I actually feel like this is worth its money. I have very puffy allergy eyes and I feel like this moisturizes the area and it actually works.
I've been dealing with dry, peeling under eyes. This has helped so much! I love the formula and the ease of use.
It is a nice eye cream, but not outstanding. Didn't help with puffiness.
The product went on smoothly and lasted all day It brightened up my eye area

This is the best eye cream I've ever used! I can truly tell a difference in the puffiness and lines around my eyes after I use this cream. The applicator is also great and allows me to fully apply the cream and still be gentle around my eyes.
Feels so smooth and light. The slight tint makes a difference in the brightening effect. Enjoying my eye cream.

I absolutely love the product. Feels good. Looks good. I expect there will be benefits that occur over time since ingredients are fantastic. Dispenser is nice & works well, with ease. Thank you! the only reason I reduced a star is because the product had already been used, when it arrived. See photos. (Also, other products were used or had damaged packaging upon arrival, despite outer boxes were fully intact, so it was not a shipping issue. Photos depict this. Please see in depth review of full impact to this order, under my review of Complexion Stick, Willow which also arrived with damaged packaging, making it hard to open.) Overall, I believe your formulations are sensational & just the very natural, skin nourishing light coverage I'd been wishing for, so I thank you for that. But, your quality control on this order was a bit horrendous, and did not occur during shipping, so must have occurred during packing. I thought you needed to know about it, so you can do the right thing to rectify the problem. Hope you will. Best, Tiffany
I enjoyed using it. It's gentle, vegan, and clean beauty. Didn't burn my skin.

I watched several videos before applying and even after a week, still not convinced I'm doing it right. The tip feels nice on my skim, bur doesn't smooth as well as id hoped. I see a slight brightness to my undereye area.

This is my second tube of Bright Start Eye Cream because it is simply fabulous. It is soothing and moisturizing to my under eye area and it really HAS alleviated my dark circles. The more I used it, the lighter they became! I also use it on my lids and brow bone areas because it is so silky and relaxing to those areas. I use it morning and evening. I like it so much I have put it on my auto refill list. It is a product that hat delivers.

avis.titre: New go to AM eye cream
avis.texte: I am using the Milk product and the skin tint. I have added this eye cream in my AM skin routine and I love it. My under eye feels tighter and I see it brighter. It also keeps my under eye hydrated and my Ilia concealer sits well on top.
I can only apply properly using my finger & I do not care for the pearl shine.
This is soft and warming to apply to my eyes. I love it so much!!
Good product that really does brighten tired eyes. Goes on easily and lasts all day, yet comes off at night without a lot of scrubbing! Be careful not to apply too much, a little goes a long way!

avis.titre: Nice, but applicator not as useful
avis.texte: I got this eye cream hoping it would help my Under eye concealer crease less. It does help a little, but not sure how effective it is as an eye cream. I also thought the applicator was really cool when I purchased online but in reality it's not very practical.

I noticed an improvement as soon as I applied it for the first time. After 2 week, my under eyes look brighter and fine lines appear smoother. I have VERY sensitive eyes and this product does not irritate or cause eye tearing. This is now part of my daily routine!

avis.titre: A product you don't know you need until you try it!
avis.texte: I tend to have dark circles under my eyes and I've been consistently unhappy with using concealer to mask this. Foundation and concealer that work well on my face aren't the right shade for the blueish shade of under-eye circles. I don't really understand how this product works, but it does. I tried it under my eyes before applying my foundation on top of it, and it worked like a charm. A little goes a long way. The directions say to apply a few dots and then blend, but I've found you only need a couple of dots under each eye.
Amazingly I have no more lines around my eyes and the puffiness under my eyes is gone. This stuff is magic!
Love the consistency and feel of this eye serum. Love its fragrance free. Makes my skin hydrated and smooth. Using for a few days and look forward to great results
Gave me a dry patch under eyes after using for only 4 days. Made my under eye concerns more accentuated. Not good. Can't use now so a complete was of money.
I haven't seen any long term effects yet but this helps to brighten area and smooth skin

This eye cream is seriously amazing! It does a great job of eliminating dark circles and puffiness. I love that it comes with an applicator and I like to cooling sensation of using the applicator. Would highly recommend!
Love the product & the applicator. Makes it so easy to apply. My eyes feel hydrated & I see improvement!

Love! I have been using it about 3 weeks now and have definitely seen an improvement in my under eye circles. Does not irritate either- I have super sensitive eyes and find it hard to find products that don't bother them.
Goes on nicely but must wait for it to dry or soak in before putting on concealer.
I love the applicator and so far, the product is living up to its promises. I'll have to wait a bit on that to add another star! But happy so far:)
I really noticed an improvement in my under eye circles after using this. The built-in eye roller is wonderful as well-very cooling and soothing. Highly recommend!
I love this eye treatment, I do see improvement after using it a few weeks and will buy again. Love the applicator as well, it smooths the product on gently with no pulling.
Super star eye cream! Goes on great underneath my Ilia concealer. Perfect product!

Love this product! My eye area has been a focus of mine since I was in my early 20's and Ii would say I've tried all eye creams and this one has been the best! Helps a dark circles and gives your eyes life!

I would be lost without this. It plumps my under eyes and makes me look awake. I use this every morning, it goes under my eyes very smoothly, the ceramic applicator feels cool and smooth no tugging or pulling. It is slightly tinted but quickly blends effortlessly.
I got the free sample of this in a previous order and feel that stuff was a bit more brightening than the actual product, but I love how it feels!
I received a sample of this product and then ended up purchasing it. This is one eye cream that helps reduce puffiness and moisturizes without causing small wrinkles.
I am 67 years young and still very active so why not add a real winner to my morning makeup routine. Both the tinted moisturizer and the Bright start from Ilia complete the job!

I rarely use eye cream but this one is flipping amazing! I've been using it daily even without makeup! It's cooling, depuffs, and brightens. Plus it doesn't get globby or peel when I put foundation on over it. Love love love it.

I first tried this as a sample when purchasing a different product, and I've been impatiently waiting to purchase the full size once I'd used up the eye cream I had at the moment. I'm thrilled with this product! It makes a noticeable difference in the smoothness and texture of my fine lines around my eyes, and it is a dream on my highly sensitive skin. I'll never use another eye cream!
Fantastic eye cream that brightens, reduces the look of tired eyes, and makes me feel good.

avis.titre: Like it - just started using so time will tell….
avis.texte: The application is nice with the tip shape and it takes very little product-goes a long way. There is a nice smooth finish with slight glow. I am hoping that I will see some reduction in the under eye puffiness that has come with aging.

why is there glitter in this product? it spreads all over the rest of my face when i finish my routine. if you don't mind the glitter bomb it's fine i guess? gonna try to use the rest of it but will definitely not repurchase

The skin under my eyes was dull and dry and just a few weeks into this eye cream I am beginning to notice the difference, softer and less dark, still have to use the concealer but both go together very well. Love the brightness !

Love this product! Goes on beautifully, hydrates and doesn't irritate sensitive skin. Will continue buying forever! Looks great with makeup as it truly does brighten your eyes! As a mom with a young child, I need the extra help!

This eye cream is super smooth, hydrating and illuminating. I keep it in my purse to use during the day when I look tired or to refresh my eye makeup

avis.titre: It works great on my tired eyes
avis.texte: I wake up a bit puffy and have bags sometimes and shadow under the eyes in the morning. I use different product at bad time but in the morning it's is my new favorite! It brightens up my eyes , smoothens the wrinkles and give beautiful golden glow.

It does seem to help my makeup keep from creasing around my eyes but so far hasn't really done anything miraculous for my fine lines or circles under my eyes.

I love this eye cream so much. Quite hydrating and beautifully brightens the under eye area. The ceramic tip feels very nice to smooth the product on. I've used it almost daily since the beginning of December and have noticed quite a difference in my under eye area. Less dark and the fine lines have diminished. Overall, really pleased.
I love this eye cream! It's moisturizing, plays well under ilia's makeup, and doesn't have harsh chemicals. This will be a staple in my routine for a long time.
It diminishes fine lines and gives a healthy glow to the under eye area. Also it feels soothing and cool
The applicator is great but I was just left with shiny undereye bags. Almost glittering… oh well
I have been using for awhile and I love the way it makes my eyes feel and look.
This is the best eye cream! The difference after applying is very noticeable. It works beautifully with the true skin concealer! Thank you!
This is the second time I ordered this product. I like how it goes on the eye area. Eye concealer or foundation glides easily over it.
Great little add to my morning regimen! Definitely worth the try.
I love this product. Just a tiny amount is enough to hydrate the area. Skin looks vibrant so I don't feel like I need to apply concealer all the time.
I love the application and the results. My eyes look less wrinkled and brighter.
Love this product! But my skin is too sensitive for it sadly. Caused bumps/rash under my eyes. Wish I could use it though, I really liked it.

avis.texte: I love this product! I have always had dark rings genetically though having two boys hasn't helped matters 😂. After years of trying to hide the dank rings with makeup that hardly never worked, this product works and works easily!

I am hoping to see my dark circles disappear!I also have had trouble in the past with product that has chemicals near my eyes. This is gentle and doesn't irritate my eyes or the sensitive skin underneath my eyes.
